news.title: Roommate shot, killed during fight over where kitchen items belonged
news.summary: A Clayton County woman has been sentenced to years in prison after prosecutors said she shot her roommate during an argument about where he was placing his belongings in their shared kitchen.

news.title: Former Georgia State football player identified as victim killed in Atlanta shooting
news.summary: The medical examiner's office says Demazio S. Skelton Jr. was the victim who died in a shooting in Vine City. Friends and family say he played football at GSU.

news.title: 3 charged after parking deck crash ends in Dunwoody shooting
news.summary: Three men face charges after a minor car crash in a Dunwoody apartment parking deck sparked a fight that ended in gunfire Tuesday, according to police.

news.title: Arrest made, victim identified in Atlanta apartment shooting
news.summary: A 19-year-old man is accused of murder after a deadly shooting at a downtown Atlanta apartment complex on Tuesday left one person dead and three others with gunshot wounds.

news.title: Illegal switch, burglary tools recovered after suspects target cars in Atlanta
news.summary: Two people were arrested after Atlanta police say a group was seen trying to open vehicle door handles in a northeast Atlanta neighborhood.

news.title: Alleged cartel leader indicted in Atlanta after ocean plane crash
news.summary: A Bahamian man faces federal drug trafficking charges in Atlanta after U.S. officials rescued him from an Atlantic Ocean plane crash, federal prosecutors announced.

news.title: Five suspects in custody after police chase in north Atlanta
news.summary: A Cobb County Police Department officer reportedly had an injury not considered life-threatening in the incident.

news.title: Officer injured as police chase ends in Cobb County
news.summary: Four arrested and three fugitives sought after a Cobb County police chase left an officer injured near Riverview Road SE.

news.title: 5 arrested after chase ends in Cobb County, 1 officer injured
news.summary: Five suspects are in custody after a police pursuit in Cobb County that ended Wednesday near Riverview Road, according to the Cobb County Police Department.

news.title: Mom found with gunshot to head in 1999 never investigated by police; suspect appears in court nearly 30 years later
news.summary: 29-year-old Bridgett Lockhart was found in her Atlanta home.

news.title: Arrest made in deadly shooting, robbery at Atlanta apartments
news.summary: Police said a man suspected in a shooting and robbery that resulted in one man dead and two others injured is now in custody. The suspect was also shot.

news.title: Man hospitalized after shooting at Buckhead apartment complex
news.summary: A man is recovering in the hospital after being shot in the leg during a dispute in Buckhead early Wednesday morning.

news.title: Man shot after crash in Dunwoody parking deck leads to argument, gunfire, police say
news.summary: After the collision, the people involved began arguing, and the woman called her boyfriend to the scene.

news.title: Wanted man flees moving SUV, caught after Forsyth County manhunt
news.summary: A traffic stop in downtown Cumming escalated into a manhunt after a driver ran from a moving vehicle, according to the Forsyth County Sheriff's Office.

news.title: 1 dead, 3 hurt in shooting inside apartment in Atlanta's Vine City neighborhood
news.summary: One person was pronounced dead at the scene.
